phase_timings.whole_wall_scope: main entry through latest observation, including config/metadata, preparation, loads, updates, evaluation and releases; excludes interpreter/import startup and final timing-file serialization
phase_timings.GPU_hours_definition: wall_seconds/3600 is allocated-device occupancy while this exclusive process owns the GPU; it is not measured CUDA-kernel active time
phase_timings.update_GPU_hours: per-variant training_gpu_hours only covers synchronized optimizer-update blocks; excludes preparation, loading and evaluation
phase_timings.inference_timing: internal evaluation sampling/decode consumes cached latents; not end-to-end RGB-to-RGB inference
phase_timings.failure_scope: handled Python exceptions; abrupt OS termination must additionally use service status/journal
